mapper.insert: INSERT INTO photo (report_id, profile_id, object_key, content_digest, media_type, byte_size, preview_object_key, preview_media_type, preview_byte_size, page_order, storage_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{profileId}, #{objectKey}, #{contentDigest}, #{mediaType}, #{byteSize}, #{previewObjectKey}, #{previewMediaType}, #{previewByteSize}, #{pageOrder}, #{storageStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_id, profile_id, object_key, content_digest, media_type, byte_size, preview_object_key, preview_media_type, preview_byte_size, page_order, storage_status, created_at, updated_at FROM photo WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE photo SET storage_status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND storage_status IN ('PENDING', 'COMPLETE')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.byte_size + COALESCE(p.preview_byte_size, 0)), 0) FROM photo p JOIN report r ON r.id = p.report_id WHERE r.created_by = #{accountId} AND p.storage_status IN ('PENDING', 'COMPLETE')
SELECT DISTINCT report_id FROM photo WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND content_digest = #{contentDigest} AND storage_status = 'COMPLETE' ORDER BY report_id
